source: IC Markets EU Ltd live research account (local account identity retained only in ignored source manifests), cTrader CLI server-tick backtest
purpose: Assess XAUUSD quote-stream coverage and timestamp integrity for the exploratory 30-minute warmup / 15-minute outcome idea; no economic or execution claim
coverage_probe: For each date, inspect only source observation count, first/last timestamp, invalid quote count, duplicate/reversed timestamp count and largest gap. Validation-date prices, spreads and outcomes remain sealed until a candidate and measurement contract are frozen.
prospective_analysis_interval_utc: 08:00–16:00 on each selected date, with preceding 30 minutes and following 15 minutes available for boundary checks
selection_rule: One fixed Tuesday in each alternate month, chosen before these new source probes. Dates are a feasibility sample, not a random or representative market sample.
exposure_history: The date list and 2021 metadata-only policy preceded the new probes. The measurement question and 30-second gate were fixed after inspection of 2020 source/spread distributions but before any 2021 quote payload. The numeric precision correction followed one 2020 development calculation; its superseded artifact remains retained locally and identified by hash in the audit.
limitations: Historical tick callbacks do not establish historical decision availability, independent broker quote fidelity or executable costs. The 2021 metadata probe consumes source-availability blindness but not price-outcome blindness.

development_measurement_v1.question: Within each selected 2020 date, do higher ranks of prior 30-minute spread variability accompany higher ranks of next-15-minute spread stress?
development_measurement_v1.anchors_utc: 08:15, 08:30, ..., 16:00 at 15-minute spacing on each selected date
development_measurement_v1.sampling: At each integer UTC second, use the latest quote whose event_time is <= that second. Never fill from a later tick.
development_measurement_v1.numeric_method: Compute bid/ask spread with decimal subtraction, then use linearly interpolated percentile position p*(n-1); normalize reported USD-per-ounce metrics to 8 decimal places before rank ties are assigned. This precision clarification supersedes an initial float-subtraction development calculation and was made without opening 2021 quote outcomes.
development_measurement_v1.quality_gate: Every second in both windows must have a quote at most 30 seconds old; otherwise retain the anchor with INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE and no metric.
development_measurement_v1.input_metric: IQR of one-second bid/ask spreads, in USD per ounce, over the lookback
development_measurement_v1.outcome_metric: 95th percentile of one-second bid/ask spreads, in USD per ounce, over the next 15 minutes
development_measurement_v1.summary: Report case metrics and per-day Spearman rank correlation; the day, not the overlapping anchor, is the independence unit. No p-value, economic payoff, threshold, live abstention or promotion claim.
development_measurement_v1.validation_policy: Do not open 2021 quote payloads or compute 2021 outcomes in this slice. A later candidate must be frozen before any such evaluation.
